thread:
Maya (Marketing): Heads up — planning a small developer content sprint for next week: OSS reference app launch + 3-part tutorial series + a community webinar. Goal: drive signups, repo stars, and a handful of inbound trials. Draft plan: https://docs.google.com/example :spiral_calendar:
Liam (DevEx): love it. can we scope the tutorials so they map to common dev flows? e.g., local dev -> deploy to Dedicated -> add caching. short hands-on labs.
Priya (Product Marketing): +1. want a two-paragraph launch post + benchmark narrative we can cite (latency/cost numbers). who will own the benchmarks?
Ravi (Eng): I can run the microbench for the reference app. will do perf on a c6g/nvidia instance and a quantized run. output format: CSV + sample curl snippets.
Maya (Marketing): perfect — owner notes: Liam -> tutorials, Priya -> launch post & messaging, Ravi -> benchmarks & PR, Juno -> community webinar ops, Sam -> inbound routing/lead capture. pls ack. :white_check_mark:
Liam (DevEx): ack. I'll draft the tutorials and a repo skeleton by Tue. thinking of 3 labs: 1) quickstart (local), 2) scale & batching (Dedicated), 3) cost tuning & quantization. each < 20 min.
Juno (Community): webinar idea: "From hello-world to production with Redwood" — 45 min, demo + 15 min Q&A. we should recruit 2-3 early adopters for short testimonials. I'll ping the community list. :speaker:
Sam (Sales Ops): for inbound, let's use a special HubSpot form + utm_campaign=refapp_launch. Route to queue: inbound-oss. Also add an automation to tag MQLs with "refapp-demo-request". I can produce the form by Wed.
Priya (Product Marketing): messaging iteration: need 3 versions of the lead magnet copy — technical, product value, and enterprise. we'll A/B test in the webinar signups and blog CTAs. Drafts by Thu morning.
Ravi (Eng): quick note on the reference app: the README will include this quickstart snippet — please review for clarity:
```
# install
pip install redwood-inference
redwood login --api-key $REDWOOD_KEY
redwood deploy refapp --model redwood-llama-7b
```
Liam (DevEx): can we include a minimal Dockerfile example too? a lot of users copy-paste that.
Maya (Marketing): good call. add a code tab in the tutorial for both pip and docker.
Juno (Community): timeline check: webinar tentatively Fri of next week. can we confirm speakers by Wed? also want a signup landing page (Maya/Priya).
Maya (Marketing): tentative schedule: Mon: repo + tutorial drafts, Tue: benchmarks + perf numbers, Wed: launch post draft + webinar speakers locked, Thu: landing page + HubSpot form + A/B copy ready, Fri: webinar dry run.
Sam (Sales Ops): will wire HubSpot and create tags. also proposal: add a simple webhook to push registrant leads to #sales-inbound for faster follow-up.
Priya (Product Marketing): for benchmark narrative, Ravi — can you produce a 1-paragraph summary with two bullets: latency @ 128 tokens, cost per 1k tokens? we can include as a figure.
Ravi (Eng): yes. I'll attach the CSV and a short table in the post. estimate numbers by end of Tue.
Liam (DevEx): I'll open the repo under org: redwood-examples/refapp and add an ISSUE_TEMPLATE for community contributions. want to make it easy to fork.
Maya (Marketing): owners and action items noted. please update the doc with availability. any blockers?
Priya (Product Marketing): need legal sign-off on the benchmark claims — I'll loop in @legal after Ravi posts numbers.
Ravi (Eng): noted. will flag assumptions (instance type, sequence length distribution) in the CSV.
OpsBot: Scheduled reminder set for thread: follow-up on drafts in 72 hours.
Maya (Marketing): thanks everyone — small, focused launch. will do daily check-ins in this thread. :rocket:
